mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increase and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are negatively impacted.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increase and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of quarters with negative GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP decline and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity and potential for increased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increase and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening in the housing market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between HOUST decline and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and CPI inflation is above 3%, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as high interest rates and inflation erode corporate profits.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of high FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate simultaneously decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity and potential for increased consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent month-over-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures signals strong consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates robust economic activity and potential for increased corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of months with positive RSAFS growth, or the correlation between RSAFS increase and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
